heading: Connect to Deskmony Core
description: Using Deskmony in a browser requires connecting to a running Deskmony Core server first.
tokenLabel: Auth token (leave blank if the server has authentication disabled)
tokenStorageNote: The token is kept only in this tab's sessionStorage and is cleared automatically when the tab is closed — it is never written to the address bar or browser history. On a shared computer, click "Log out" in the main interface or simply close this tab when you're done.
